notes.title: Update Version 1.1.3
notes.content:
Update to 1.1.3
-What is new:
.new objective: john will now follow you to complete a new task
.added new scenario
.added simplified inventory system
.added new enemies
.fixed several bugs
.added an option to reduce pixelation
.improved performance.
.added randomized Loot that may help your HP or STM
.Added limited lives for increased difficulty
